defect.finding: The parent text requires the post-compile recovery to run the preferred production verifier while starting zero additional Blender processes. The frozen verifier necessarily starts one separate Blender artifact-audit process, so the literal conjunction is impossible even when no compile is repeated.

authorizedCorrection.scope: Replace ambiguous aggregate Blender wording with disjoint native-compile and artifact-audit process categories everywhere the parent matrix, gate and operation ceiling are interpreted.

effectiveMatrixInterpretation.BASELINE_B01: one native compile Blender plus one artifact-audit Blender
effectiveMatrixInterpretation.ORCHESTRATOR_EXIT_AFTER_COMPILE_B01: the first invocation starts one native compile Blender; recovery starts zero additional native compile Blender and one artifact-audit Blender through the preferred verifier
effectiveMatrixInterpretation.BLENDER_INTERRUPTED_B02: one interrupted native compile Blender, one recovery native compile Blender and one artifact-audit Blender after recovery success
effectiveMatrixInterpretation.LIVE_PROCESS_REFUSAL: zero native compile or artifact-audit Blender starts by the refusal invocation

unchanged: manifest, ledger, receipt, recovery and writer rules
34-gate denominator; exactly one gate label is replaced
100 GiB reserve plus 0.5 GiB projected write
zero render, model, network and Docker operations
effectiveDecisionRule: SUPPORTED requires all 34 effective gates, at least 64/72 parent attacks, 8/8 correction attacks and exact disjoint process accounting. Any second native compile after a valid compile-stage receipt is REJECTED even if mislabeled as audit work.
nonClaims: This correction does not execute or validate the orchestrator
An artifact-audit Blender process is not a render and does not write cinematic output
Disjoint accounting does not weaken the no-repeat rule for completed native compilation
